p20ConnectNote: Connect to see the playlist stored on your device
p20ConnectWifi: Join the device Wi-Fi on your phone, then tap Connect device.
p20ReadFailed: Could not read the device playlist
p20OrderNote: The order comes from your device. Moving a video updates the device and reads back the confirmed order.
p20PendingNote: These videos are waiting on your phone and have not been uploaded to the device.
p20Unconfirmed: The device did not confirm the change. Its current state has been refreshed. Check it and try again.
p20UploadEntry: Open from a device playlist to upload
p20FramingNote: Saving records only the framing. Tap Convert and upload to prepare and transfer the device files.
p20UploadDisconnected: Connect to the device from Home before uploading.
p20UploadDaily: A daily playlist accepts videos with or without sound. With audio: extract MP3, convert, upload audio then video. Without audio: convert and upload video only.
p20UploadBluetooth: B Bluetooth playlist accepts videos with or without sound. Convert and upload video only; source audio is ignored.
p20UploadDownloadFirst: Download this video to My Characters before uploading to the device.
p20UploadFailed: Preparation or upload failed. Check the video, device connection and storage, then try again.
p20UploadBusy: Device is busy. Try again shortly.
p20UploadWriteFailed: Device could not write the file. Check its storage card.
p20UploadAlreadyExists: The file already exists on the device.
p20UploadStorageFull: Device storage or playlist is full.
p20UploadBatteryLow: Device battery is too low. Charge it and retry.
p20UploadConfirmationTimeout: Device confirmation timed out. Note the stage and progress below, then reconnect.
p20UploadProcessingTimeout: Media processing timed out. Try a shorter video.
p20UploadConnectionLost: Device connection was lost. Reconnect and retry.
p20UploadLocalFileError: Cannot read or write local files. Check the source and available phone storage.
p20UploadInvalidReply: Device reply or progress sequence did not match. Check the firmware protocol.
p20UploadPartial: Audio was uploaded but video did not finish. No device files have been deleted or automatically retried.
p20UploadRefreshFailed: The device confirmed the upload, but the playlist could not be refreshed. Reconnect and refresh; do not upload again.
p20UploadCleanupPending: Temporary files are still in use and have been retained.
p20UploadExtractingAudio: Checking and extracting audio if present
creatorMediaOpenFailed: Unable to open this video. Refresh your submissions and try again.
creatorMediaThumbnailPending: Thumbnail not ready. Tap to preview.
